definition.q: oracle-correct draws divided by all draws
definition.mu: pooled correct-draw mean WNS-derived post-route Fmax over the combined arm; unlike a mean of per-seed conditional means, a correct RTL whose Vivado implementation failed contributes 0 MHz
definition.F: mean penalized Fmax over all draws, with every non-correct or implementation-failed draw at 0 MHz
definition.weighting: equal draws per design and 48 draws per combined arm endpoint

correctness_structure.weighting: candidate multiplicity within design, then equal weight over designs with correct support in SFT, RF, and correctness-only

selected_case.selection_rule: argmin over common-support designs of correctness-only minus SFT conditional Fmax; lexicographic design-name tie break
selected_case.representative_rule: candidate nearest its arm's multiplicity-weighted conditional Fmax; then greater multiplicity; then module name

correctness_structure.interpretation_boundary: These lexical structures characterize retained correct endpoint RTL. They do not include incorrect draws, prove a unique causal mechanism, or establish that every correctness-only sample is a wide combinational block.

best_of_n.selector: perfect selector using true retained post-route Fmax; an unattainable upper bound on practical reranking
best_of_n.sampling_model: with-replacement draws from each design's observed 48-draw empirical distribution; incorrect and implementation-failed draws are 0 MHz
best_of_n.cost_axis_boundary: Draw and oracle counts are exact workload units. Raw-correct and deduplicated implementation counts are empirical expectations. Actual generated-token and GPU-second costs are unavailable because all raw generations and timings were not retained.
